title: migrate_academic.ipynb

canonical_node.axiom: Academic migration is the conversion of validated results into citable, paper-ready formats.
definitions: Academic migration: the process of reformatting JSON results and PNG charts into LaTeX tables, equations, and BibTeX entries.
Paper-ready format: LaTeX-compatible tables, properly formatted equations, and standard academic citation format.
Citable: having BibTeX entries that link to established literature.
derivation: The notebook exists to produce LaTeX equation blocks, LaTeX tables, BibTeX entries, and an abstract draft.
These outputs are intended for direct inclusion in a LaTeX document for academic submission.
The presence of this notebook indicates intent to move beyond website demonstration toward formal publication.
canonical_node.action: Reformat validated results into LaTeX-compatible tables, equations, and BibTeX entries for academic submission.
boundary: Does not generate new scientific results.
Does not validate or test the underlying physics.
Does not produce web-ready JSON or PNG outputs.
Does not itself perform peer review or guarantee acceptance.
test: Check that all major equations are formatted in LaTeX.
Check that test results are presented in tabular form with required columns.
Check that BibTeX entries are present and correctly formatted.
Check that an abstract draft is included.

dg1_dependencies: Validated results from test notebooks (JSON and PNG outputs).
The framework's equations and test outcomes.
Established literature references (Klein, Gordon, Riess, Planck, DESI, Shannon, Kolmogorov).
dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Enables conversion of results into paper-ready LaTeX and BibTeX formats for academic submission.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the underlying results and equations in a citable format.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: Without this node, the project lacks a documented path to academic publication; results remain in web-only formats.

classification.recommended_atom_action: preserve as methodological node; do not treat as evidence for physics claims

overstatement_risks: The existence of LaTeX formatting may be misinterpreted as validation of the underlying physics.
BibTeX entries may imply stronger connections to established literature than actually exist.
The abstract draft may be mistaken for a peer-reviewed publication.
kill_conditions: If the underlying results are invalidated, this node's outputs lose value.
If the notebook is not reproducible or the outputs are not actually generated, the node fails its purpose.
risk.lean_target: Keep this node as a formatting and citation tool; do not let it inflate the epistemic status of the framework.

plain_summary: This notebook converts existing results into LaTeX and BibTeX formats for academic submission. It does not add scientific evidence; it only prepares outputs for potential publication.
